title: Billing waiting for review
summary: Bill or skip the periods automatic billing held back.

steps.text: {title} lists the periods automatic billing held back because each is further behind than its agreement's catch-up window. Bill the ticked periods, or skip them with a reason; each agreement bills its oldest period first.
You can also ask the assistant which periods are waiting, or to bill or skip them. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
